findings.summary: The heating heading was a literal and ungrammatical Bengali rendering.
evidence: The previous title used কি গরম প্রভাবিত করে, which does not naturally express factors affecting heating.
findings.resolution: Changed it to যে বিষয়গুলো উত্তাপকে প্রভাবিত করে.

findings.summary: The explanatory paragraph confused electrical power with electrical energy.
evidence: The previous Bengali term শক্তি did not distinguish the power rate described by the English source.
findings.resolution: Used বৈদ্যুতিক ক্ষমতা and clarified the heat-capacity and heat-flux relationship.
